blogs.title: Beyond the Transformer: Why LSTMs Are Making a Massive Comeback
blogs.description: We explore the surprising resurgence of Recurrent Neural Networks. This post breaks down why, despite Transformers dominating recent years, researchers realized that scaling LSTMs with modern tricks could finally match and potentially surpass sOTA performance in language modeling.

blogs.title: The Secret Sauce of xLSTM: Exponential Gating and Scalar Mixers
blogs.description: A deep dive into the 'sLSTM' architecture introduced in xLSTM. Learn how replacing standard sigmoid gates with exponential functions and adding a clever 'normalizer state' solves a specific flaw in old LSTMs, allowing them to revise what they've learned on the fly.

blogs.title: From Scalars to Matrices: How mLSTM Out-competes Attention
blogs.description: Discover the architecture behind 'mLSTM,' which abandons the scalar memory cell for a matrix-based system inspired by human associative memory. Find out how this simple change gives the model infinite storage capacity and full parallelization, beating Transformers at long-context tasks while remaining linear in complexity.

blogs.title: State Tracking Explained: Why xLSTM Keeps Context Better than Transformers
blogs.description: Can AI really understand complex logic like counting or tracking objects across thousands of words? We explain the concept of 'state tracking' demonstrated in xLSTM's experiments, showing why non-parallel models often hold long-term abstractions better than attention-based systems like Llama or Mamba.

blogs.title: Speed vs. Capacity: The xLSTM Trade-off for Edge Devices
blogs.description: Transformers get slower as your context grows; xLSTM does not. In this practical guide, we analyze xLSTM's linear memory complexity and decoding speed, discussing why this architecture is uniquely poised to power efficient AI agents on phones and IoT devices without context-length limits.
